raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: PySDL2
  version: "0.9.17"
  md5: 8dd193d3b01d949b256b5bb95c277dc6

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | lower }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  md5: ${{ md5 }}
  patches:
    - no_sdl2dll.patch
    # Test fixes merged upstream after the 0.9.17 release, needed to make the
    # test suite pass against sdl2-compat (SDL3) and FreeType >= 2.14.0.
    - 280.patch
    - 281.patch
    - 283.patch
    - 284.patch
    - 288.patch
    - 290.patch
    - 291.patch

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    env:
      SDL_VIDEODRIVER: dummy
      SDL_AUDIODRIVER: dummy
      SDL_RENDER_DRIVER: software
    content: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - sdl2
    - python

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - sdl2_ttf
        - sdl2_mixer
        - sdl2_image
        - sdl2_gfx
        - numpy
        - pillow
        - sdl2
    script:
      env:
        SDL_VIDEODRIVER: dummy
        SDL_AUDIODRIVER: dummy
        SDL_RENDER_DRIVER: software
      content:
        - if: python_impl != 'pypy'
          then: python -m pytest --pyargs sdl2.test -vvl -rxXP

about:
  license: CC0-1.0
  license_file: doc/copying.rst
  summary: A wrapper around the SDL2 library
  description: |
    PySDL2 is a wrapper around the SDL2 library and as such similar to the
    discontinued PySDL project. In contrast to PySDL, it has no licensing
    restrictions, nor does it rely on C code, but uses ctypes instead.
  homepage: https://github.com/py-sdl/py-sdl2
  repository: https://github.com/py-sdl/py-sdl2
  documentation: https://pysdl2.readthedocs.io

extra:
  feedstock-name: pysdl2
  recipe-maintainers:
    - dschreij
    - a-hurst
    - Tobias-Fischer
